node.title: MDS-dual flats: termination is TRIVIAL (no sparse words exist)
node.statement: For coordinate-prefix/fiber flats the dual is (shortened) MDS: no words below the Singleton range, so the support lattice is trivial and the descent tree has size 1. The moment count applies immediately. Corollary of f_consumer_scoped branch (a).
